title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 1. Purpose & Background
text:
1. Purpose & Background
This document defines the final business requirements for the Feedback Mapping submodule within Stores
Management on the Reciproci platform. The module enables marketing and loyalty team members to map
Feedback url (EN/AR)s and WhatsApp Template IDs to stores by uploading a CSV file. Once configured, the
system must send a personalized WhatsApp notification to customer’s post-transaction, featuring a Call-to-Action
(CTA) button that links directly to the client's Voice of Customer (VoC) feedback survey.
Two existing modules underpin this feature:
• Stores Module — manages POS and eCommerce channel stores.
• Templates Module — stores pre-built WhatsApp notification templates with language variants.
Feedback collection and analytics remain on the client's external VoC platform. Reciproci is responsible only for
sending the WhatsApp notification.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 2. Stakeholders / Role Team Responsibility

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 3. Scope / 3.1 In Scope — Phase 1
text:
3. Scope
3.1 In Scope — Phase 1
• Feedback Mapping single-page UI under Stores Management.
• Upload Name field and CSV upload via Browse Files or drag and drop.
• Validate File: on-click pre-submission analysis showing Total Records and Store with Links.
• Download Template: downloadable sample CSV from within the upload form.
• Download Store List CSV: full store configuration export from the toolbar.
• Upload history table: Upload ID, Upload Name, Total Stores, Download, Uploaded On, Uploaded By.
• CSV merge logic: update, deactivate, and reject rows per defined rules.
• Post-transaction WhatsApp notification — one per committed transaction.
• Personalised notification: First Name and Store Name attributes only.
• Language-preference dispatch from customer profile with fallback.
• Notification tracking log.
• Communication Channel Control Registry extensible for Phase 2.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 3.2 Out of Scope — Confirmed
text:
3.2 Out of Scope — Confirmed
The following are explicitly excluded from Phase 1 and must not be built.
• Customer ID — not in notification payload or tracking log.
• Transaction ID — not in notification payload or tracking log.
• SMS and Email notification channels — Phase 2.
• Per-customer channel preference and multi-channel fallback — Phase 2.

4. UI Design — Confirmed Screens
The following screens are the accepted design source of truth for development. All field names, layouts, labels,
and interactions described in this document are based on these screens.
4.1 Screen 1 — Feedback Mapping List View
Screen 1: Feedback Mapping list — upload history table with Search, Download Store List CSV, and Upload feedback url
(EN/AR)s controls.
Key elements confirmed from this screen:
• Page name: 'Feedback Mapping' (breadcrumb and page title).
• Sidebar item: 'Feedback Mapping' under Stores Management, highlighted in orange.
• Search bar centered between breadcrumb and action buttons.
• 'Download Store List CSV' link — top right, before the Upload button.
• 'Upload feedback URL’s' button — orange, top right.

4.2 Screen 2 — Upload Form (File Uploading)

• Orange 'Validate' button positioned below the file info on the right.
• 'CANCEL' (dark) and 'UPLOAD' (orange) action buttons — bottom right of the form.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 6. Business Requirements / BR-01: Store Feedback Configuration
text:
6. Business Requirements
BR-01: Store Feedback Configuration
Each store is mapped to exactly Feedback url (EN/AR) and one WhatsApp Template ID. If either is missing, no
notification is sent for transactions at that store.
• Active Feedback URL(EN/AR) and one active Template ID per store at any time.
• Template ID must reference an active WhatsApp template in the Templates module.
• Both fields validated at upload time; invalid Template IDs cause the row to be rejected.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: BR-02: CSV Upload / 6.2.1 Required CSV Format / Column Type Mandatory Description
text:
BR-02: CSV Upload
6.2.1 Required CSV Format
Column Type Mandatory Description
Store ID String Yes Must exist in the Stores module.
Store Name String No Reference only — not updated by upload.
Feedback URL (EN) URL Conditional* VoC survey link for this store.
Feedback URL (AR) URL Conditional* VoC survey link for this store.
WhatsApp Template ID String Conditional* Must reference an active WhatsApp template.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: BR-03: Validate File
text:
BR-03: Validate File
Validate File is a pre-submission read-only analysis of the attached CSV. No data is committed.
• Runs on the attached file only — no database lookups at this stage.
• Returns: Total Records (all data rows) and Store with Links (rows with both URL and Template ID
populated).
• If no file is attached, shows: 'Please attach a file first.'
• Replacing the file resets, the validation results.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: BR-04: Post-Transaction WhatsApp Notification
text:
BR-04: Post-Transaction WhatsApp Notification
• Trigger: transaction committed event received in real time from POS or eCommerce system.
• One notification per transaction. No cooldown or de-duplication applied.
• Notification includes Call-to-Action (CTA) button that links directly to the client's Voice of Customer (VoC)
feedback survey.
• If store is inactive or unconfigured: notification suppressed silently.

Attribute Source Fallback

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 7. User Stories & Acceptance Criteria / US-01: Upload Store Feedback Mapping / Field Detail
text:
7. User Stories & Acceptance Criteria
US-01: Upload Store Feedback Mapping
Field Detail
User Story As a marketing/loyalty user, I want to upload a CSV from the Feedback Mapping page
so I can map Feedback url (EN/AR)s and WhatsApp Template IDs to stores without
leaving the screen.
Acceptance Criteria Given I am on the Feedback Mapping page, When I click 'Upload feedback URLs'
(EN/AR), Then the upload form expands on the same page. And I enter an Upload
Name, attach a CSV via Browse Files or drag and drop, and click UPLOAD. Then the
form closes and the history table refreshes with the new batch.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: US-02: Validate File Before Upload / Field Detail
text:
US-02: Validate File Before Upload
Field Detail
User Story As a marketing/loyalty user, I want to validate my CSV before uploading so I can check
Total Records and Store with Links without saving any data.
Acceptance Criteria Given I have attached a CSV file, When I click 'Validate', Then 'Total Records' and
'Store with Links' appear above the Validate button. And no data is committed to the
system. And replacing the file clears the results.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: US-03: Download Template / Field Detail
text:
US-03: Download Template
Field Detail
User Story As a marketing/loyalty user, I want to download a sample CSV template from within
the upload form so I know the required column format.
Acceptance Criteria Given I open the upload form, When I click 'Download Template', Then a CSV file
downloads containing the required column headers: Store ID, Store Name, Feedback
url (EN/AR), WhatsApp Template ID.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: US-04: Download Store List CSV / Field Detail
text:
US-04: Download Store List CSV
Field Detail
User Story As a marketing/loyalty user, I want to download the current store list as a CSV so I can
audit all store feedback mappings.
Acceptance Criteria Given I click 'Download Store List CSV' in the toolbar, Then a CSV downloads with
exactly five columns: Store ID, Store Name, Feedback url (EN/AR), Template ID,
Uploaded On. And all stores are included regardless of status. And stores with no
Feedback url (EN/AR) or Template ID show blank in those columns.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: US-05: Receive Personalised WhatsApp Notification / Field Detail
text:
US-05: Receive Personalised WhatsApp Notification
Field Detail
User Story As a customer, I want to receive a personalised WhatsApp notification in my preferred
language after a transaction so I can complete the feedback survey.
Acceptance Criteria Given a committed transaction at an active, fully configured store, When the
transaction event is received, Then one WhatsApp notification is sent using First Name
and Store Name as personalisation attributes. And the message includes the Call to
Action Button which redirects the Feedback url (EN/AR). And the message is in the
customer's preferred language (fallback to template default).

Upload

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 9. Process Flows / 9.1 Upload Process
text:
9. Process Flows
9.1 Upload Process
1. User navigates to Stores Management > Feedback Mapping.
2. Clicks 'Upload feedback url (EN/AR)s'. Upload form expands on the same page.
3. Enters Upload Name. Attaches CSV via Browse Files or drag and drop.
4. (Optional) Clicks 'Validate'. Total Records and Store with Links appear. No data saved.
5. Clicks UPLOAD. System validates: file format, mandatory columns, Store IDs, Template IDs.
6. Form closes. History table refreshes with new batch at top.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 9.2 Post-Transaction Notification Process
text:
9.2 Post-Transaction Notification Process
7. Transaction committed event received from POS or eCommerce system.
8. Store ID extracted from event.
9. Channel Registry checked only ACTIVE channels eligible.
10. Store configuration checked active Feedback url (EN/AR) and Template ID required.
11. If inactive or unconfigured: notification suppressed.
12. Customer's First Name and preferred language retrieved from customer profile.
13. Store Name retrieved from Stores module.
14. Matching language variant of WhatsApp template selected (fallback to default).
15. Personalisation attributes injected: {{First Name}} and {{Store Name}}.
16. WhatsApp notification dispatched with Feedback url (EN/AR) within Call to action Button.
17. Dispatch event logged with all BR-07 fields and delivery status.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 10. Non-Functional Requirements / ID Category Requirement
text:
10. Non-Functional Requirements
ID Category Requirement
NFR-01 Performance Notification dispatch within 30 seconds of transaction committed event.
NFR-02 Performance CSV upload processing within 60 seconds for up to 500 rows.
NFR-03 Performance Validate File response within 3 seconds for up to 500 rows.
NFR-04 Performance Feedback Mapping page loads within 3 seconds.
NFR-05 Reliability Notification failure logged without affecting store or transaction data.
NFR-06 Scalability Concurrent transaction events across all active stores handled without
degradation.
NFR-07 Auditability All upload events stored and visible in the history table.
NFR-08 Data Integrity CSV upload atomic per row — failure on one row does not affect others.
NFR-09 Extensibility Channel Registry supports new channel activation via config update — no
code deployment.
NFR-10 Usability Upload, validate, view history, and download all available on the single
Feedback Mapping page.

title: Feedback Mapping BRD Final
section: 11. Assumptions & Dependencies / 11.1 Assumptions
text:
11. Assumptions & Dependencies
11.1 Assumptions
• All Store IDs to be mapped already exist in the Stores module.
• WhatsApp templates with language variants (EN, AR minimum) exist in the Templates module before
use.
• Customer profiles always contain a non-null preferred language and first name.
• Transaction committed events delivered to Reciproci in real time.
• Client's VoC platform generates Feedback url (EN/AR)s independently.
• Customer ID and Transaction ID are excluded — no future change without a new requirement.
